# M3 phase 1: power checks (v2.1; sec. 12.1 trapped pot, synthetic; sec. 12.2 three pairs)

*Generated by `scripts/generators/fit_m3_strecker_layer.py --power`. R = 200 synthetic sets per truth; binomial demotion rule: one-sided Fisher exact test of power against false credit at 0.05; power < 0.5 is 'low power'. The trapped pot on SYNTHETIC data at 20 / 40 / 80 / 160 / 320 min (the keyed Figs. 2 - 3 were not opened). Design: prereg v2 + the v2.1 amendment (sec. 22). SINGLE LABORATORY.*

**NOT FROZEN; UNDECIDABLE ON DISK (coordinator, 2026-11-05): under v2.1 no decisive contrast reaches usable power. The route credits R1 only, at 0.065 vs 0.01 under four-form agreement. Transfer and decay law are demoted. Phase 1 moves to W6 (prereg sec. 23). The keyed hofmann2000b Figs. 2 - 3 rows were never read and remain unused.**

REUSABLE ESTIMATOR: the adaptive-tempering SMC (smc_lppd / smc_replicated; independence MH moves in logit space; k replicates for the stated error) passes V-SMC (a) against an exact grid and V-SMC (b) on a 32-dimension case with a known answer, where reweighting fails. It resolved U3 at 32 - 35 coordinates in 4.5 - 10 min per density, and is reusable for other held-out densities of ~30 - 35 coordinates.

CF CANDIDATE (for the register session; not filed here): every rival over-predicts Table 2's argon PA + PAA. The median is 0.39 - 0.48 mM and q10 0.11 - 0.24 mM, against a measured 0.09 mM. In the 4 096-draw sets only 5.7 % of R1 draws and 15 % of R2 draws come within 2x of it. The cause is shared structure (route A / EX-049's calibration, or the ARP-Phe exits), not the rivals: see prereg sec. 23 for the reading.

## Approximations (declared)

- draw sets are scrambled-Sobol prior draws conditioned on the calibrations (feasible only), reweighted per synthetic set (sec. 12.2's 'by reweighting'); a density whose PSIS k-hat >= 0.7 or ESS < 100 reads 'not resolved' (a tie, unchanged rule); results ignoring that rule are reported beside
- draw sets enlarged to 4096 feasible draws per rival and form (2048 for the truths) under the v2.1 amendment; the SMC fallback (v2.1) is NOT run per synthetic set (its measured cost: checks record), so an unresolved density stays a tie here: power is conservative on that account
- tie bands from 40 measurement-noise redraws per unit and set (the prereg's 4 000 for scoring)
- censored U3 values: product of conditional marginals (exact for one); adequacy leaves them out
- Holm's guard step is not simulated: power is optimistic on that account
- synthetic sets are generated from the truth's primary-form predictions and scored under each form
- a rival with no feasible draw under a form (its calibration infeasible there) has lppd -inf: the other side is read as favoured under that form without its adequacy test (flagged by_infeasibility; optimistic)
- U3a / U3b are built from the same synthetic trapped data as U3; U3a's Table 2 argon PA is synthetic from the truth (its print error, s_rep, run offset and omega)
